newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Kumho Merchant Bank closes $50 mln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Kumho Merchant Bank closes $50 mln FRCD.

text.p: Kumho Merchant Bank's US$50 million floating rate certificate of deposit issue has been allotted, bankers said.
They said the facility has a final maturity of five years with a put and a call option in year three.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 81 basis points.
Lead managers with US$5 million each are Baring Brothers, Bayerische Vereinsbank, KDB Bank UK, Kookmin Finance Asia and Sumitomo Finance Asia.
Co-lead managers with US$4.5 million each are Hanil Bank Hong Kong and Housing and Commercial Bank Korea Tokyo.
Senior managers with US$3 million each are Commercial Bank of Korea London, J.P Morgan Securities Asia, Societe Generale Asia and Sumitomo Trust International.
Senior managers with US$2 million each are Sanwa International Finance and Seoul Bank of Luxembourg.
